description: A LOINC laboratory test, described by its names and six LOINC axes. Component-axis relationships identify what the test measures or is about; System-axis relationships identify the anatomical or cell-type specimen in which the measurement is taken.

common_properties.name: identifier
common_properties.description: LOINC test code in the form LOINC:<code>.

common_properties.name: name
common_properties.description: Fully specified long common or preferred test name.

common_properties.name: component
common_properties.description: LOINC Component axis: the analyte measured or entity the test is about.

common_properties.name: system
common_properties.description: LOINC System axis: the specimen in which the measurement is taken.

common_properties.name: loinc_property
common_properties.description: LOINC Property axis, such as mass concentration (MCnc), number concentration (NCnc), substance concentration (SCnc), presence/threshold (PrThr), or titer (Titr).

common_properties.name: scale
common_properties.description: LOINC Scale axis, including quantitative (Qn), ordinal (Ord), nominal (Nom), and narrative (Nar).

common_properties.name: loinc_class
common_properties.description: LOINC discipline class codes and decoded class labels, such as CHEM, MICRO, or ALLERGY.

common_properties.name: status
common_properties.description: LOINC release status: ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED.

common_properties.name: sources
common_properties.description: Data sources contributing the test; contains LOINC.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Date and time the node was created or last changed.

source_contributions.scope: Laboratory codes (CLASSTYPE = 1) with ACTIVE, TRIAL, or DISCOURAGED status, and at least one identified Component-axis analyte relationship. DEPRECATED codes are excluded. LABORDERS.ONTOLOGY order codes are included and can duplicate observation-code counterparts. LOINC parts, answer codes, and groups are not represented as ClinicalLab nodes.
source_contributions.description: Native LOINC laboratory test definitions are supplemented with BioPortal UMLS identifiers. Panels are represented through their own components; panel-to-member relationships are not included. Native LOINC and BioPortal releases may differ, limiting UMLS enrichment for newer parts.

properties.name: synonyms
properties.description: Alternative test names from LOINC RELATEDNAMES2 or synonyms.

properties.name: method
properties.description: LOINC Method axis, such as molecular genetics (Molgen), immunoassay (IA), PCR (Probe.amp.tar), or IHC (Immune stain).

properties.name: cui
properties.description: UMLS concept identifier supplied by the BioPortal LOINC enrichment.
